Open Team Race:- 1.Windsor & Eton 25pts, 2.Cambridge 63pts, 3.TVH 94pts. Middlesex Champ. 1.I.MacIntosh (Ran), 2.D.Sparkes, 3.T.Hart (BELGRAVE H)

Belgrave's 17th Open 20 miles was won by Ian MacIntosh (Ranelagh) in the good time of 1:47:30: a good time indeed, for in the oppressive heat 24 of the 84 starters were forced to retire, including our own Brian Gorman who spent the night in hospital suffering from heat exhaustion.

Conditions were good and at 5 miles there was a bunch of 8 runners together; Mike Hurd and Don Faircloth (Croydon H), Dave Patterson (TVH), Paul Earles (Windsor S & E), Colin Taylor (Airdale & Spen Valley), Ian Macintosh (Ranelagh), Tom Moore (Liverpool H) and Tom Roden (S.L.H.).
